notes.title: Spring Sales & Update 1.1 are now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
[h3][b]Dead Alone is now available on sale at -25% as part of the Spring Sale event! Make sure to grab it before March 21st! [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472482/aadba89acae8c4ae2cd6acbf9044d9ebd196259e.png[/img]



Today I also got a small new update for the game, which include many bugfixes and changes reported by some players! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472482/af73f64aedaf192ba405ec7e859658e04938326f.png[/img][list]
[*] Added the ability to remove traps that did not yet explode
[*] Fixed a major issue that could cause the player to be soft-lock during the introduction if he did not have anymore ressources to build a trap
[*] Reworked projectiles physics to fix projectiles glitching through walls and floors
[*] Fixed an issue in the construction site area that could cause zombies to spawn in areas that could not be reached by the player
[*] Fixed an issue that could create a corrupted save file when opening a bunker
[*] Fixed various issues with save files that could load incorrect datas
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause zombies to spawn directly after respawning, which is not intended
[*] Fixed and improved AI path finding in several areas of the map
[*] Improved performances at night in foliage-dense areas
[*] Fixed an area that could cause the player to fall under the map
[*] Improved collisions on several objects across the map to allow for better navigation in the map and avoid collisions that could stuck the player
[*] Various UI-related bugfixes
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause some menus to not open at low framerates
[*] Fixed various visual glitches on zombies models
[*] Slightly increased the detection radius for the buildable traps
[*] Various other small changes and bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.41 update available to playtest !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !

I first want to thanks everyone playing the playtest and sending me valuable feedbacks !

I got a small update for Dead Alone today, it includes a complete rework for the workbench UIs and many quality of life changes and fixes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541400/Dead_Alone/]Make sure to add Dead Alone to your Steam wishlist if you want to support me ![/url]

Anyway, let’s check what changes this update brings with the patch notes right below !

[h3]Features:[/h3]
With this update, the Workbench UI has been completely redone to offer a more easy and clean experience when navigating the different menus, I have made a quick video to showcase this brand new UI: 

[previewyoutube=HPfXtTvyU2I;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, let’s talk a bit about the changes that have been done. Overall, all the UI elements have been simplified to reduce the number of actions required to do a specific thing. The simplification also help greatly to display only the most important and relevant informations without useless visual clutter. 
[list]
[*] First of all, the initial menu that showed up when interacting with the workbench has been removed and the 3 sub menus are now accesibles through tabs on top of the screen. When interacting with the workbench, you will now be presented directly with the weapons list menu, no more useless clicks !
[*] The weapons list menu has seen a lot of changes too, the list is now more compact with only the most important stats visible for each unlocked weapon, the 3D model of the weapon is also displayed on the right of the screen.
[*] The details and upgrade UI for weapons has also been completely reworked. You can now see all the stats of the weapon on the left panel as well as the upgrades available on the right, when hovering an upgrade you will see the new stats compared with the current one in a way more intuitive and simple manner. 
You can also see stats such as killed ennemies, headshots, accuracy, etc with the “show weapons stats” button on the bottom.
[*] Once you are done with weapons, you can take a look at the equipement upgrades panel ! Here, all the useless submenus have been removed and merged into one single UI. 
You can directly see the list of all the equipements on the left with only the relevant stats and informations. And on the right all the available upgrades for the hovered equipement. 
Just like for the weapons, hovering each upgrade display the new stat compared to the current one.
[*] And finally, the Crafting UI has also seen some various changes, the list of crafts on the left has been simplified and now only require an hover to display the selected craft instead of doing it with a button. The UI on the left and right have also been reworked to reduce instances of overlapping on some screen resolutions. 
The crafting list for ammunitions has been tweaked to display ammos for the equipped weapons on top of the list in order to make it easier to craft relevant ammunitions
[/list]

All those changes allow for a better and far easier experience when navigating this very important menu.

[h3]Changes and fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each weapon type now has a specific crosshair
[*] Improved animations when swapping weapon while reloading
[*] Improved visual and audio feedback when taking damages
[*] The resolution setting will now display all available resolutions for the screen plugged in instead of a fixed set of resolutions
[*] Improved AI attacking behavior to reduce instances of unregistered hit
[*] Added particle effect when the player is on fire. Molotov and explosive barrels now also properly deal fire damage over time
[*] Various improvement to UIs
[*] Improved AI reaction and feedback to melee attacks
[*] (Horde) Fixed a major issue that caused the shop to close instantly after opening it
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the crafting system to always consider the sleeping buff “Clever Crafting” as active
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the “break timer” to be skipped even if the player did not press the input
[*] Various fixes to the ‘window mode’ settings not being applied correctly
[/list]
